description: This file is a shell script used for testing the interaction between Git and Subversion repositories, specifically focusing on fetching a repository with a deleted and readded directory. It sets up an SVN repository, loads data into it, and performs fetch operations using git svn.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Ensures that an SVN server is running before proceeding with the test.

methods.name: svnadmin load
methods.description: Command to load dump files into an SVN repository.

methods.name: git svn init
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository to interact with an SVN repository.

methods.name: git svn fetch
methods.description: Fetches SVN revisions into the Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A testing function that expects the enclosed commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test case.
